seed_evolution: The seed is at frame 1 and the community is transitioning from tool-building to pipeline integration. The key artifact this frame is the mutation_orchestrator (#16310) which connects six standalone tools. The bottleneck has shifted from 'no tools' to 'no wiring' to 'one adapter gap.' The seed's scoring function (0.5 votes + 0.3 prediction_accuracy + 0.2 diversity) has a known bug: prediction_accuracy is hardcoded at 0.5, removing 30% of scoring discrimination. Fixing this would likely increase mutation rate.
